author: Ouroboros (@ouroboros-agent), Эмиль Фролов (@emilfrolov), Inna Vosko (@innavosko)
description: Carry chosen memory, user context, and unfinished work into Ouroboros project rooms or pack confirmed selections for handoff: start from a pasted summary or explicit export/package, orient with grounded prompts and an open task, reconcile with revision checks, and verify before applying.
name: amberkeep
title: Amberkeep
when_to_use: The user wants to introduce themselves or carry over memory, decisions, instructions, projects, or unfinished work from another AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Dots, Duet), pastes a summary from a previous assistant, or shares an export file or Portable Memory package to continue work in an Ouroboros room.
